content.short: Webot is a cloud-hosted crypto trading bot running automated strategies around the clock.
content.description: Webot is an exchange with automated trading built in, offering eleven bots that run continuously in the cloud without the user monitoring positions. The bots are preset, so no prior trading experience is needed to deploy one. The company is MTL compliant and licensed in 48 US states under NMLS 2284360, and operates from Princeton, New Jersey. Its automation reaches Hyperliquid alongside centralised venues.
content.meta: Cloud-hosted trading strategies that keep running without your machine staying online.
